edbDesc: The motion of molecules in solutions or particles in suspensions in response to an external force such as gravity, centrifugal acceleration or electromagnetism. Sedimentation may pertain to objects of various sizes, ranging from suspensions of dust and pollen particles to cellular suspensions to solutions of single molecules such as proteins and peptides.
title: Sedimentation
pickWhy: An everyday process (particles settling out); the deck already has the Ultracentrifuge that exploits it.
